predeclaration.common_start_offsets: 0 plus every first-candidate duration; identical domain for all first candidates
predeclaration.future_assignment: joint target-to-(exposure,fibre) winner matching; no fixed greedy suffix assignment
predeclaration.first_alternatives: strong actual source action plus same field duration variants
predeclaration.positive: same nonzero first candidate is certified strict winner at all three fixed sensitivities
predeclaration.no_incumbent: retain greedy nonoverlap time path with exact fixed-path fibre matching and upper certificate; classify as failed solver; do not extend time
predeclaration.negative: no stable certified change; retain result and stop without expanding samples
predeclaration.scope: public-prefix conditional model ranking only; no old feedback after changed action; no full season
